I am a woman here in Lindi, farming my maize on this plot of about two and a half hectares. The soil here is sandy and not so strong, and fertilizer from the shop is expensive and hard to find in our village, so I will just use some manure from my goats and chickens to help the soil. I plant my own seed that I kept from last harvest, together with cassava between the maize rows, because cassava saves us when the rains fail. I work with my children on the plot, and when it is time to weed or harvest I call a few neighbors to help for small pay.
